articleTitle: Automated System for Checking Works with Free Response Using Intelligent Tutor’s Comment Analysis in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Students of engineering specialties preparation requires the use of a large number of laboratory works, practical works, calculated-and-graphic works and term papers in educational process. In general, the results of implementation of these works are presented in the form of free response and cannot be automatically checked by comparison with model answer defined by a tutor. Difficulties, arising during checking student works in the conditions of online learning, present a major problem. The problem is compounded by the fact that tutors must provide detailed responses about works, which includes comments, relating to errors made by students. It is suggested to apply intelligent technologies with the use of checking systems, which analyse the content of student works, in existing papers. However, the software is specific and has very limited applicability, especially in the field of engineering education, because student works contain a large quantity of illustrative material in addition to the text. A method for checking student works with free response using intelligent tutor’s comment analysis and automated checking system based on the method are proposed in the paper. The use of the system allows to facilitate and accelerate the work of tutor during preparing reviews about student works with free response, which is relevant for engineering education. The results of the system approbation during checking calculated-and-graphic works in Ufa State Aviation Technical University are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Modern Open Source IC Design tools for Electronics Engineer Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article researches the problems of using free and open source tools for integrated circuits (IC) design as viable alternatives for expensive commercial products in electronics engineer education. Main steps of modern IC design flow discussed. OpenLane as an example of a software that combines different free and open source tools capable of performing such flow was used in this work. The practical example of OpenLane tollkit use is shown.

articleTitle: Jupyter Notebook, JupyterLab – Integrated Environment for STEM Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article deals with the application of integrated environments Jupyter Notebook and JupyterLab in the learning process together with STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, Mathematics) technology. It is shown that these environments support basic learning activities including formulating problem statements with formulas and images, performing scientific and engineering calculations, computational experiments, creating graphical user interfaces, publishing interactive e-textbooks, and interactive web-applications. The article describes how to conduct classes using Jupyter Notebook and JupyterLab.

articleTitle: Information Architecture to Support Engineering Education in the Era of Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In order to meet the demands of Industry 4.0, the education system faces the task of forming the image of a student, which can be solved by creating his digital twin. The article discusses the existing approaches to the application of this technology in education. In the field of informatization of the educational process, they will form a development vector of student's educational trajectory. The technology of creating a digital twin of a student and the tasks that can be solved with its application are considered.

articleTitle: Engineering Education in the Conditions of Transition to Distance Learning in the Pandemic Period: Empirical Assessments and Forecasts
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the organization of the transition of engineering education from traditional education to distance learning in the emergency conditions of a pandemic, its legislative form, problems and development prospects. The main attention in the work focused on the results of an online survey of students of the Federal State Budgetary Educational Institution of Higher Education "NRU" MPEI "on the level of their satisfaction with the educational activities of the university in the context of the exclusive use of e-learning and distance educational technologies. In the process of the sociological study, the problems of a sharp transition to a remote format identified. The experience of problems must take into account in the future. The opinion about the effectiveness of distance learning in the implementation of the educational process was confirmed.

Author Keywords: problems and consequences of the transition to e-learning

articleTitle: Work with Free Response Implementation Process Analysis Based on Sequential Pattern Mining in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Learning process, its dynamics are one of the points of focus of researchers which conduct studies in the field of education. The widespread use of learning management systems and MOOC platforms allows to create and store records of student activities in educational system (logs). In educational process special systems for implementing assignments of a particular type, for example, software development, construction of concept maps, can be used together with MOOC platforms or learning management systems. These special systems can also keep logs of student activities. The logs are an analytical issue in applying educational data mining, in particular in sequential pattern mining. The use of sequential pattern mining makes it possible to identify typical patterns of student activities during the learning process. These patterns may be used in defining potential problems for students and courses with a goal of improving educational process through course corrections or through providing special feedback to students with problems. However, the usage of sequential pattern mining approach is limited to the majority of works with free response, widely applied in engineering education. A method of work with free response implementation process analysis based on sequential pattern mining is proposed in the paper. The method was tested in training future engineers in the field of information technologies in Ufa State Aviation Technical University on the results of distance term paper preparation in the course "The design of automated systems for information processing and control". The use of the suggested method allows to extract undesirable patterns of implementing works with free response and reasons for their presence. Also, the method allows to define typical strategies of implementing such works and their proportions.

articleTitle: Instrumental Software Environment for Teaching Students the Technology of Designing Intelligent Decision Support Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The transition to the "Digital economy" requires training of specialists in the field of modern information technologies using artificial intelligence. The National Research University "Moscow Power Engineering Institute" in a department of "Applied Mathematics and Computer Science" in the master's program "Artificial Intelligence" provides training of students in methods and tools for designing intelligent systems, including their most complex representatives – intelligent decision support systems in real time. This paper considers the application of the Decision-making Modeling System developed at the Department of Applied Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence, used by students when performing laboratory classes in the disciplines "Methods and decision support systems" and "Intelligent decision support systems".

articleTitle: Real-Virtual Platforms for Organizing Research Activities of Students of Technical Universities in the Process of Teaching Technical Translation
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The problem of increasing the efficiency of the process of teaching a foreign language in technical universities through the use of modern information technologies is relevant enough. The current article discusses the methods of teaching technical translation using authentic materials from the Internet, provides a theoretical justification for the need to improve the effectiveness of methods of teaching a foreign language in nonlinguistic universities, identifies the specifics of the organization of students' educational activities using virtual-real platforms. The paper presents the results of an empirical study of students' participation in an experiment, during which they conducted a study of the grammatical features of authentic scientific articles. The results of the study prove the high efficiency of using realvirtual platforms in the organization of research activities of students in the process of their training in technical translation.

articleTitle: The Development of the Information and Educational Environment of the University through the Improvement of a Multifunctional Technological Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article shows how the system of vocational education implements the tendency of increasing the role of innovative information and communication technologies to improve the quality of training specialists. The organization of the activities of the «Moscow Financial and Law University MFUA» is described through the use of the electronic information and educational environment (EIEE) of the university in the educational process. The main purpose of EIEE is the acquisition of knowledge, skills, abilities and competencies by students in accordance with federal state educational standards, regardless of the time and location of students. Modules, components and elements that consist the technological platform of EIEE are presented in this article such as: the service of the ability to create individual courses and modules for the use in the formation of individual educational trajectories of the students; the service of accounting of requests of representatives of business communities; the service of the electronic admission committee with the possibility of remote submission of documents and exams; the service of increase in the objectivity of the assessment; the attendance tracking system.It is argued that the development of an effective model of a digital university based on EIEE allows maintaining a high level of training for the digital economy, creating comfortable conditions for training and successful realization of the educational potential of the future specialist.

articleTitle: Educational Desktop for Remote Modeling of Wireless Computer Networks subject to Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The educational resource considered in this article is a remote access workplace designed to study the structures of computer networks based on combined combinatorial block design, taking into account regular or irregular constraints on connections, as well as key systems based on combinatorial block diagrams, taking into account structural constraints and restrictions on the use of keys. A computer network based on the combined combinatorial block design has internal subnets corresponding to its blocks and external subnets corresponding to its dual blocks. The structures of these networks are specified by regular constraints. Random constraints correspond to possible failures of communications or failures of computers. A computer network equipped with a key system based on a combined combinatorial block design has key pools of nodes, the composition of which corresponds to blocks, while dual blocks include numbers of nodes containing the corresponding keys. Structural restrictions correspond to the exclusion of individual nodes, and the restrictions of the key system consist in the exclusion of individual keys from all node pools (if the key is compromised) or from individual pools (if it is not installed in them). The listed types of restrictions are typical for wireless sensor networks and their key systems. The educational resource allows you to remotely simulate processes in computer networks of both types, taking into account the specified restrictions. Such laboratory workshops play an important role and are an obligatory part of the educational process in the professional training of masters in applied mathematics and informatics.

articleTitle: An Object-Oriented Approach to Ontology Modelling in Specialists Education of Methods and Technologies of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Training highly qualified specialists in modern digital and information technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI) methods and technologies tasks Higher educational institutions. Since the 2021/2022 academic year, a new educational program, "Artificial Intelligence", has been introduced at the Department of Applied Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence of the NRU "MPEI" when studying for a master's degree in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science. In new academic disciplines, "Applied Intelligent Systems" (AIS) and "Intelligent Decision Support Systems", students learn and acquire practical skills and competencies in AI models and methods and implement prototypes of modern AI systems for various purposes.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach to the Mathematical Description of Induction Heating Installations Using Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses an integrated approach to the mathematical description of induction heating installations using information technologies, providing for a joint consideration of the processes occurring in the induction heating device, power source (system) and control system, using modern digital modeling environments implementing numerical methods, physical, geometric, structural and simulation modeling, as well as the theory of similarity. Examples and advantages of such an approach to the consideration and study of processes and installations of induction heating are given.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Information-Analytical and Industrial and Technological Processes in Production Based on Neuro-Fuzzy Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The industrial and technological processes are supported by information-analytical processes for effective functioning within a complex system. Such processes ensure that the collection and analysis of information, as well as modeling and making control decisions for the industrial and technological process. A variety of neuro-fuzzy Petri nets with temporal fuzzy neurons is proposed. An example of constructing a model of an industrial and technological process and the corresponding information-analytical processes is considered. The developed specialized software for modeling industrial and technological processes and the implementation of information-analytical processes is considered.

articleTitle: Implementation of Project Activities in Engineering Education on the Example of the Educational Program "Space Technologies"
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Specificities of the project activities teaching within frames of the authorial educational program "Space Technologies" are considered in the paper. Nowadays project activities are being implemented widespread, but among all programs, special attention is paid to engineering education. This is related to the necessity to train young specialists who will be capable to solve complex and non-standard tasks. It should be noted that the implementation of project activities takes place both at the level of higher and secondary education. To solve this task, teachers with practical experience are involved, who have mastered all the nuances and complexities of project activities. The implementation process takes place in various ways: from setting individual or group tasks in the subject or discipline program to allocating certain time and premises for working on projects. But the purpose of this implementation remains unchanged, regardless of the form or level of education: to educate the young generation, ready not only to perform standard work, but also to invent and produce really working products and services in demand. This paper discusses methods of organization and examples of project activities based on the engineering educational program "Space Technologies", main results of developed projects are presented. A detailed description of space objects and models designed on the space simulator "Kerbal Space Program" basis can be found by linking to articles from the list of references, where the feasibility of created space objects is based on modern achievements of science and technologies is proved.

articleTitle: Impact of Pandemic Conditions on Organization of Industrial Internship
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the problems of organizing the industrial internship of students in the context of a significant expansion of the possibilities of technologies, the dynamics of the structure of the demand for professions. An improved scheme of information flows and the document management for internship registration is proposed. The issues of organizing internship in the field information security are considered. The generalized experience in realizing industrial internship in the conditions of obligatory transition to distance learning, the efforts of Moscow Power Engineering Institute personnel and employees of partner organizations caused by the COVID-19 pandemic is presented.

articleTitle: Visual Analytics and Its Applications in Electronic Engineering Education : BMSTU Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In this paper we consider a possibility to use visual analytics in electronic engineering education. Our investigation focus is on the aspects of their applications in Bauman Moscow State Technical University. We present our results and talk about opportunities of using visual analytics in academic process.

articleTitle: To the Issue of the Balanced Program "Engineering and Computer Graphics" for Engineering Specialties
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Currently, there is a need for good geometric training of students in engineering graphics courses at the university, using advanced computer tools.Well-developed spatial thinking is important for any discipline. The Power Engineering Design Department (MPEI) is constantly looking for different ways to solve the above-mentioned problem, modernizing traditional training programs. We propose the consolidated methodology of teaching engineering students the discipline "Engineering and computer graphics", based on the diverse experience of specialists of different ages, education and professional development.

articleTitle: The Concept of Application of Computer Technologies for the Educational and Research Laboratory on Theoretical Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the experience and concept of using computer technologies for the educational and research laboratory on Theoretical Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering (TFEE). The methodology of using various simulation and circuit modeling environments for conducting an automated (computer) experiment is successfully used in the preparation of bachelor students of the Institute of Electric Power Engineering and the Institute of Electrical Engineering and Electrification at NRU «MPEI» for full-time, part-time and distance learning. Examples of the implementation of basic laboratory work and specialized work using the technologies of machine calculation of electrical circuits are given.

articleTitle: Fractal Characteristics of the Network Traffic
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The problem of analyzing the fractal characteristics of network traffic is considered. Fractal properties of legitimate traffic and traffic with various types of DDoS attacks is analyzed. The possibility of detecting illegal traffic using the fractal theory and different methods for the Hurst exponent estimation as well as the reliability of the proposed approach is carried out. The advantages of using the geometric fractal index proposed by the authors for the rapid detection of different types of DDoS attacks are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Program for the Selection of Sites to construct Renewable Energy Plants based on the Method of Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP)
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Modern energy development involves the widespread use of power plants based on renewable energy sources (RES), such as hydropower, solar, wind, geothermal, tidal, wave, etc. This direction is associated not only with the struggle for carbon neutrality, but also with ensuring the energy security of territories that provide themselves with energy from their own energy resources, and renewable energy sources in one ratio or another are available in any country in the world. However, the modern view of the use of renewable energy sources is mostly related to the gross potential of energy resources. Although, all organizations that have built at least one plant of this kind clearly understand that there are many reasons that do not allow using the rich gross potential of renewable energy in practice. There are natural or climatic anomalies, instability of international or internal political relations, and the absence or lack of qualified personnel, the necessary design, construction and operation of renewable energy facilities. The task of choosing the location for the construction of priority renewable energy facilities is one of the central ones for the energy strategy of the countries. This task is the subject of this article, which proposes the practical use of the methodology created bythe authors in the form of the software package "Program for the placement of installations based on renewable energy sources in a given territory" in C ++ language for choosing optimal places for the construction of renewable energy plants using the method of analytical hierarchies. The power complex, the location of which is assessed by the program, includes a solar photovoltaic plant, a hydraulic plant, a wind plant, and a tidal electric plant. With the help of the "Program for the placement of installations based on renewable energy sources in a given area", the selection of optimal locations for the construction of renewable energy plants in Myanmar was carried out.

Author Keywords: software package "Program for the placement of installations based on renewable energy sources in a given area"

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of the Flow Past the Three-Row Staggered Drop-Shaped Tubes Bundle at the Different Angles of Attack
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The turbulent flow passing three-row staggered drop-shaped tubes has been simulated by ANSYS software package. The results of the drop-shaped tubes bundle were compared with those of circular tubes having the same equivalent diameter. Four angles of attack θ= 0°, 45°, 135°, and 180° without and after drop-shaped tubes deformation were discussed. The flow pattern around the drop-shaped tubes bundle were predicted .The results indicated that the drop-shaped tubes bundle showed its superiority over a circular one in terms of high thermal-hydraulic performance under the same operating conditions. The best thermal-hydraulic performance values were achieved at θ = 0°. Correlation for the friction factor in terms of Reynolds number, and the angle of attack was proposed.

articleTitle: On the Use of the Modern Software in the Programs of Basic and Additional Professional Education in the Field of Electric Power Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article presents the experience of using software programs for calculating, analyzing, and modeling electrical engineering and electrical power systems by students of various energy specialties, as well as trainees of professional retraining programs in the field of Electrical Power and Electrical Engineering. An assessment of the current situation regarding the use of traditional and new information technologies by employees working in the energy sector is given. The drawbacks and gaps in the knowledge of trainees being the reason of the ineffective use of computer technology in various fields of their activity are analyzed. The issues of improvement of the basic and additional education programs in the field of Electric Power Engineering at the Moscow Power Engineering Institute are discussed. The ways of applying active teaching methods for acquiring skills in solving production problems using information technologies are shown.

Author Keywords: electrical engineering and electrical power systems

articleTitle: Information System for Automatic News Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In this paper, the design and development of an information system for the classification of Russian-language news texts using machine learning algorithms are considered. The information system under consideration consists of the automatic classification system and the website. The text data has been preprocessed. A number of experiments were conducted to train classifiers using grid search algorithm. Four classification methods have been tried: naive Bayesian classifier, logistic regression, random forest classifier and artificial neural network. The classification quality of the trained classifiers has been evaluated using a number of metrics: precision, recall and F-score. The website was also designed in order to provide a convenient information system usage.

articleTitle: Use of CODESYS for Laboratory Classes in the Online Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper considers use of CODESYS for laboratory classes in the online mode. Laboratory classes for master and bachelor students of Institutes of Thermal and Nuclear Power Engineering and Energy Efficiency and Hydrogen Technologies are taken as examples. Laboratory workbenches and laboratory works are described, the advantages of CODESYS for online and off-line laboratory classes are shown. Methods and algorithms used for organizing online laboratory classes for power engineering students are described.

articleTitle: Method for Calculating Thermodynamic Properties of Poorly Studied Liquids
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the use of a virtual model of isochoric heating of various liquids in educational laboratories and in practical classes. The article proposes a method for obtaining information about the thermodynamic properties of poorly studied liquids at pressures significantly higher than atmospheric pressure, when only the density, isobaric heat capacity and the speed of sound at atmospheric pressure are known. The basis of the method is the assumption of a linear dependence of fluid pressure on temperature in an isochoric process. Approbation of the method on the example of toluene up to pressures of 50 MPa gave satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Application of "DIgSILENT PowerFactory" Software Complex for Remote Laboratory Studies of Ring-type Electricity Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper describes the possibility of using the software complex "DIgSILENT PowerFactory" in the implementation of the educational process in a remote format for laboratory work on the discipline of Electrical Power Systems and Networks. The relevance and advantages of the presented approach compared to physical network simulations on laboratory benches are shown. An example of a laboratory study of the parameters of ring-type power networks using the PowerFactory software "DIgSILENT" is given.

articleTitle: Virtual Laboratory Work «Isothermal Compression of Real Gas»
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The laboratory workshop on technical thermodynamics is an integral part of the educational process. Classes in the laboratory introduce students to the basics of thermal measurements. Calculations of thermodynamic quantities using the results of measurements contribute to the consolidation of knowledge gained in classroom classes. The implementation of the virtual experiment by students is carried out offline and provides for the pre-installation of the program in the Excel 2010 – 2019 environment.

Author Keywords: computer simulation of a physical experiment

articleTitle: Bloomberg as a Component of Research
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The authors raise the problem of providing research work of students, postgraduates, and university teachers with up-to-date information on the functioning of national and international market structures, prove the need and effectiveness of using modern informational and analytical systems, in particular, Bloomberg Professional Services. The authors consider the options for using Bloomberg Professional Services in educational activities, and also offer three formats for research work using Bloomberg Terminal, assessing the effectiveness of such research.

articleTitle: Digital 3D Model in Geometric and Graphic Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Digital support of all stages of the product life cycle is a characteristic feature of modern industry. This changes the ideology of engineering work and the model of design activity, with the 3D model of the object being of great importance. It is relevant to reflect the ongoing changes in engineering education and, in particular, in the basic geometric and graphic training of students of technical universities. The article discusses 3D models in project activities and introduction of 3D technology in the program of geometric and graphic training. Practical examples are given. The advantages of innovations contributing to the formation of students' creative engineering thinking are shown.

articleTitle: Moral Guidelines in the System of Engineering Education in the Society of Industry 4.0 according to the Results of Remote Sociological Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Industry 4.0 requires new qualities of engineering work. The modern specialist, receiving engineering education, acquires system-related competences - professional abilities and skills, attitudinal and socio-cultural knowledge, personal qualities necessary for successful work activities. Soft Skills - "soft competences" are based on moral culture. The report presents some results of sociological surveys conducted by the Centre for Applied Sociological Research of NRU MPEI, which provide an insight into moral orientations of engineering students.

articleTitle: Experience in Designing and Developing a Navigator Program to Support the Educational Process at "NRU" MPEI"
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In the era of rapidly developing technologies, applications are actively being created that allows you to build routes between two objects. Such software products help to navigate in open spaces, but not inside buildings.For many higher educational institutions, consisting of many buildings, the task of navigation is also relevant. It is often difficult for newly enrolled students to navigate the complex logistics of educational buildings. Mistakes in "movement" can complicate the course of the educational process, as they potentially lead to a disruption of training sessions.This article describes the relationship between navigation software technologies (navigators) and graph theory and discusses various algorithms for finding a path on a graph. The Lee algorithm or the wave algorithm is discussed in more detail.Practical experience of developing a navigator for indoor orientation, regardless of the type of building, be it a university, a hospital, or a shopping center, is given. The technologies for implementing the application and the results of trial operation are described. The development was tested at the National Research University "Moscow Power Engineering Institute". The developed prototype allows you to display an interactive map of buildings, build and display the shortest route between two objects. A wave algorithm is used to find a route. The implemented approach can be generalized for other organizations with complex logistics inside buildings.

articleTitle: Methods of Database Diagnostic on a Symbolic Variable
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article reviews the problem of monitoring and diagnosing factographic databases for the presence of duplicate records. The monitoring is carried out by the symbolic variable FAMILIA (that means SURNAME in Russian). A word recognition and sampling algorithm has been chosen as a reference algorithm, using match function [lit. ref. 1]. The algorithm has been significantly upgraded at the expense of applying several match functions and optimizing their setting parameter, while taking into account the instances of letter rearrangements and drop-out. General methods of searching and monitoring the files for the presence of duplicate records is proposed. The methodology is used as a tool of smart processing in the laboratory-based practicals for Applied- and Business Informatics training areas.

articleTitle: Application of Simulation Modeling as a Replacement for Laboratory Practice in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The application of simulation modeling for replacing the higher education laboratory workshop during the educational process. It is considered on the example of studying transient processes in alternating current networks and modeling the electric field of a high-voltage insulator. In the first case, a sequence of laboratory work on the study of a three-phase short circuit is proposed. The description of the the electrical system’s model in the Matlab-Simulink software package and methods for calculating the parameters of the main elements are given. In the second part, the main aspects of modeling suspended polymer high-voltage insulation of overhead power lines in the COMSOL Multiphysics 5.6 software package are considered. Analytical expressions of the electromagnetic field’s mathematical model around the insulator are given. The main stages of working with the program interface are highlighted. Recommendations on the density of the finite element mesh are given. A gradient picture of the electric’s potential distribution near the insulator’s surface is presented. The author's assessment of the possibility of introducing these complexes within the educational process is given.

articleTitle: Applying Software Packages for Designing the Power Supply System of Temporary Buildings and Constructions
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article considers various programs for designing power supply systems of temporary buildings and constructions. Examples of calculations of lighting of various objects in the DIALux software package are presented. Conclusions are made about the introduction of various programs to improve the design.

articleTitle: Increasing the Competitiveness of the University Educational Programs through Scientific and Methodological Support Using Modern Intellectual Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of increasing the competitiveness of university educational programs. To solve this problem, it is proposed to improve scientific and methodological content that ensure the implementation of appropriate educational technologies. It is highlighted that in order to solve applied problems of various levels of complexity, it is necessary to use specialized developed software along with classical programs within the framework of the laboratory facilities. Such software should take into account not only specifics and features of the real sector of the economy, but also modern scientific approaches to solving relevant practical problems. In this case, solving these problems, students operate with professional terms; acquire the ability to analyze emerging situations typical for future professional activities. As an example, the scientific and methodological support of laboratory work on discipline Operation of automated information processing and control systems (AIPCS) is considered. Brief objective settings are given, the novelty of their solution methods based on the use of artificial intelligence methods in the form of integration of heterogeneous cognitive models (HCM) and a system of hierarchical production rules with fuzzy logic is noted. The on-screen forms of the developed software implementing the proposed methods are also presented. The purposeful introduction of applied objectives into practice of teaching results in the formation of skills in operating with professional terms and the ability to analyze situations typical for future professional activities, thereby forming the graduate’s professional competence.

articleTitle: Process Design In Water Treatment: Software Choice Problem
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article describes approach for selection water treatment design software for students at the National Research University "Moscow Power Engineering Institute" (MPEI). The advantages, disadvantages and approaches are described.

articleTitle: Development of a Method for Optimizing the Voltage Mode Based on Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article studies various ways to optimize the electrical modes of electric power systems and develops a method to optimize the voltage mode by switching taps in the control device under the load. In the first parts of the article, modern promising methods for optimizing electrical modes based on fuzzy logic are considered. In the third part, a methodology for regulating the position of the on-load tap-changer (LTC) is developed to obtain the optimal voltage. In the MATLAB software environment, a fuzzy controller for the LTC is synthesized. In the fourth part, a numerical experiment is performed in a test circuit using the methodology and the fuzzy controller obtained in the third section.

articleTitle: Remote Laboratory Complex "Automated Process Control Systems of Power Plants"
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article describes the laboratory complex for studying the principles of automated process control systems (APCS) power plants implementation. The laboratory complex includes both the equipment of the control object and all the main components of modern APCS: sensors, actuators, programmable logic controllers with Input/Output (I/O) modules, workstations. The laboratory can be used both in person and remotely 24/7. The principles of organizing remote access to the laboratory complex equipment using a remote desktop and a video surveillance system are described. An important feature of the complex is an unlimited list of tasks due to a combination of various software control objects and digital exchange protocols.

articleTitle: Implementation of Some Non-Classical Mathematical Models of the Mechanics of a Deformable Body in the MathCad and MatLab System
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: On the basis of a non-classical approach to the solution of boundary value problems of statics, a mathematical model of deformation of elastic structures and their elements has been developed. This model is implemented in the MatLab system. It is shown that deformations can be determined by linear tensors of displacement gradients at any values of the latter.A mathematical model based on an equation expressing a quantitative relationship between the limiting values of the smallest and largest principal stresses is implemented in the MathCad system. The calculations performed showed that this equation determines all the stress states that lead to the destruction of the material. The envelope lines of the limiting stress circles of brittle and semi-brittle materials are constructed.In the MathCad system, the consistency of the generalized Hooke's law was tested based on a new criterion (equation of deformation diagram) derived for axial tension and compression of solid cylinders without the influence of the hypothesis of uniaxial stress state. Calculations in MathCad showed that this equation well describes the results of experiments throughout its entire length with the same values of constants of structural materials (steel 45, aluminum, duralumin).

articleTitle: The Role of Modern Software Systems in the Formation of Professional Competencies of Specialists in the Electric Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article is devoted to an analytical review of modern software products used in engineering design. The authors have determined the importance of obtaining skills to work with popular software complexes at the stage of formation of educational programs. The requirements of most employers for a graduate are the ability to perform specialized parts of a project using BIM technologies.

articleTitle: Emulation of 110 kV Switchgear in Accordance with IEC 61850
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article describes the principles of creating an emulator of electrical substation equipment in conjunction with intelligent electronic devices operating in accordance with the IEC 61850 standard. 110 kV switchgear used as example. It is shown that for the emulation such a system, minor computing power is enough and no special equipment is required. Emulation based on open-source library. An example of the practical application of such an emulator is given below.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement Methods for Hardware Accelerated Graphics Using Vulkan API
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In the present article, performance of two computer graphics application programming interfaces (APIs), OpenGL and Vulkan is compared using the application developed with C++ programming language. One of the two API’s for scene rendering can be chosen before compilation of program. OpenGL Shading Language (GLSL) is used to create shader for OpenGL backend. Simple shader with implementation of Phong-style shading was created in GLSL then compiled to SPIR-V language for Vulkan support. Results indicate that usage of Vulkan may double the framerate compared to OpenGL. Performance boost was achieved using pre-recorded command buffers, minimization of descriptor set count, using one vertex buffer and one index buffer per scene and using mip- maps for rendering. Framerate was captured using RenderDoc software.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Three-Dimensional Simulation in the Process of Teaching Students the Subject of Engineering Graphics
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article considers the use of three-dimensional graphics during lectures and practical classes on engineering graphics for the development of spatial imagination in first-year students and the use of the textbook "Workbook on the course of engineering graphics" for the successful mastering of educational material.

articleTitle: Satisfaction Survey of e-Learning Educational Programs Graduates as a Tool for Educational Process Quality Improvement and University Community Formation
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article is devoted to the conduct and analysis of the results of the satisfaction survey of graduates of online educational programs. Monitoring the satisfaction of consumers of educational services makes it possible to improve the educational process and ensure effective interaction of all parties interested in higher and additional professional education. Based on the hypothesis of creating a club of alumni, a questionnaire was drawn up for a survey of former students of the institute who graduated from programs of higher and additional education using online technologies. An analysis of the respondents' answers was carried out and recommendations were made for organizing long-term work with graduates. The results of the survey demonstrate the positive attitude of graduates to the university community creation and the identification of the need for interaction, even taking into account the electronic form of education.

articleTitle: Experience in the Development and Use of an Information System for Remote Written Tests Conducting
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the issue of conducting various exams remotely has become much more relevant. In cases of written examinations in the form of tests, numerous e-learning systems can be used. If the answers are no longer representable in the form of tests, other ways must be used. It is also important to solve the problem of monitoring the student in the process of passing the exam. This paper describes an experience for development and use of information system for conducting remote written tests.

articleTitle: UV Optimization for Game Ready 3D Assets
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Graphic technology rapidly evolve nowadays. The content creation becomes a very important direction and number of people involved in it grows every year. There are three main industries which employs specialists in computer graphics: film, games and visualisation. In this article we will consider important aspect of models creation: optimization for game engines. That includes modern game industry requirements for UV layout optimization.

articleTitle: Application of Gradient Boosting Algorithm for Predicting Equipment Failures
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article discusses the process of predicting failures of deep-pumping equipment in the oil industry. A procedure for predicting failures of oil well equipment is proposed, which is based on the application of a gradient boosting algorithm and includes three stages. At the first stage, a set of features necessary for the analysis is formed, as well as a sample of data. At the second stage of data preprocessing, the following are performed: processing of missing values; coding of categorical features; getting rid of outliers by the interquartile range method. At the third stage, the gradient boosting algorithm is applied to predict failures of deeppumping equipment. The peculiarity of the algorithm implementation consists in the proposed scheme of actions, which means sequential fixing first the number of decision trees, and then the learning rate, involving the analysis of the dependencies of the root-mean-square error on both the learning rate and the number of trees. The result of predicting failures of deep-pumping equipment of an oil well is presented and the results of experimental studies using the developed models on real data are described. The predicted value of the number of failures of the deep-pumping equipment of the oil well for the subsidiary of the company Rosneft Nyaganneftegaz was calculated. The proposed procedure for solving the problem of predicting equipment failures based on the application of the gradient boosting algorithm is advisable to use in the process of obtaining an engineering education both when studying special disciplines and when performing final qualifying works.

articleTitle: Study of the Readiness of Students to Use VR Technologies During a Course in Engineering Geometry and Computer Graphics
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Today, the virtual reality technology starts to pervade all areas of our life. The present article reviews the use of virtual reality in the educational environment. It studies the psychophysiological aspects of using VR technologies, as well as the issues of controlling the students' cognitive load when planning the educational process. General requirements for installing VR equipment and for working with it are discussed. Examples of introducing VR technologies in specific disciplines are given. The results of a survey on the readiness of first and second year students of the Federal Autonomous Educational Institution of Higher Education "Perm National Research Polytechnic University" to study the subject Engineering Geometry and Computer Graphics in a mixed format with the use of VR technologies.

articleTitle: Identification and Analysis of Priority Department Topics of Student’s Scientific Research
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article deals with the use of modern information tools at the Department of Control and Intelligent Technologies of the National Research University "MPEI" for organizing "feedback" with students, which involves conducting and analyzing online surveys on the choice of topics for Educational Research Work. It is noted that the choice of topics by students is directly related to their subsequent employment. This allows, based on the analysis of the survey results, to identify the training courses and areas of scientific research that are most in demand in practice and, in the opinion of students, are useful in professional activities (employment in their specialty). The retrospective data covers the period from 2015 to 2019 and contains 107 questionnaires. The work identifies the most popular department topics, builds their ratings, analyzes the change in student preferences over time, examines the relationship between topics. The analysis showed that the Department of Control and Intelligent Technologies has a group of Student’s Scientific Research directions that are most in demand by students. Also, topics that over time have ceased to be indicated by students as priorities and by now have significantly lost their relevance from the point of view of their usefulness in employment in their specialty are identified. It was found out which topics have stable connections with each other and often fall into the questionnaires together. The results of the analysis enable the department to forecast demand and prepare human resources to meet the increasing number of applications in popular areas. The research carried out makes it possible to automate the process of assigning students to the Student’s Scientific Research and choosing the most suitable scientific advisor. The proposed approach provides the department with "feedback", on the basis of which it is possible to correct the topics of the Student’s Scientific Research, update, adjust (and expand) courses that contribute to the employment of graduates and provide knowledge that is in demand in the modern labor market.

Author Keywords: automated processing and analyzing survey results

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm for Optimization of Heating Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: An algorithm for redistribution of flows in an oriented network is proposed, the maximum flow of which is sought by the Push-Relabel method in the Maple system of computer mathematics. At each stage of optimization, the most effective options are identified, the combination of which gives the next generation of genes. It is shown that highly ramified networks are most sensitive to the distribution of the capacity of individual branches. For example, the maximum flows in networks with two and three parallel branches of the same bandwidth are compared. It is shown which parameters of the algorithm have the greatest influence on the result.

articleTitle: Identification of the Optimal Controller Type for Hexapod with Hydraulic Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article solves the problem of developing an intelligent hexapod control system with a hydraulic actuators that provides the specified trajectories of the ball movement. A mathematical model of the platform in MATLAB SIMLUNK is presented, within which a control system using a fuzzy logic controller was implemented. A 3D model of the hexapod was built, on the basis of which a mathematical model was developed. As a result, transient curves for the system itself and for transient processes for given trajectories of the ball movement were obtained both for conventional and intelligent control. They can be implemented to judge about the effectiveness of using intelligent control based on a fuzzy controller, and besides, based upon the resulting curves, the forms of control actions in the system were selected, and the parameters were also optimized. The application of the proposed approach made it possible to ensure the high quality of hexapod control.

articleTitle: Simulation Technologies Enhancing Educational Physics Laboratory Workshops at Lomonosov Moscow State University
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article presents the issues of using simulation technologies to enable educational research of difficult to implement scenarios. It shows that it is possible to introduce students to modern scenarios of electromagnetic compatibility problem, including compatibility between satellite systems, via face-to-face, blended or distant education. Validity of simulation results is based on using relevant internationally recognized documentation of International Telecommunication Union’s Radiocommunication Sector and methodologies approved at international level as theoretical basis. Practical application examples of designed series of workshops are discussed.

articleTitle: Experience in Using Innovative Technologies in Technosphere Safety Training
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the features of training students in the center for advanced training and professional retraining of the Center for Industrial and Sphere Safety, operating based on the Department of Engineering Ecology and Labor Protection of the NRU MPEI. Analyzed the new requirements for training in labor protection, which will come into effect in 2022. The principles of a modular training program for the retraining of specialists are considered, which can be transformed depending on the level of training of the student and the request of the enterprise. The emphasis in the educational process is made on a combination of traditional teaching methods and interactive technologies, which are discussed in the article. The experience of using the innovative technology of virtual reality in the study of the module "Fire safety" is presented.

articleTitle: The Use of Virtual Reality Tools in the System of Continuing Professional Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article researches the problems of improving the education process through the use of the new state-of-the-art learning technologies, in particular the combination of 3D modeling and virtual reality technologies, the general gamification of the process. It shows that the combination of these technologies gives positive results, improves learning efficiency, simplifies and speeds up the perception of material, and improves its memorability. The example of the practical application of the virtual reality projects realized in the Centre for Science and Education "Ecology of Power Engineering" of the Moscow Power Engineering Institute is shown.

articleTitle: Application of a Multiple Choice Model with Ordered Alternatives to Analysis of Objectivity of Knowledge Test Results
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: To assess the objectivity of the results of knowledge testing, these results are compared with some reference results, the objectivity of which is not questioned. For example, a survey conducted by an experienced teacher can be considered a benchmark for automated testing results. Methods of statistical analysis are used as comparison tools. Strictly speaking, classical regression analysis is not applicable to such problems due to the discrete nature of generally accepted assessments of knowledge. Therefore, a multiple choice model with ordered alternatives is used. This article contains the statement of the problem, its solution by the method of maximum likelihood and the results of the first studies.

articleTitle: Blended Learning in the IT Educational Programme: an Example of the Programming Technologies Course
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This paper researches the blended learning technology usage for realization of the "Programming Technologies" course included in the IT programme under study in Ural Federal University. Today, blended learning has become not only prospective technology but the real necessity. The question now is not whether to blend or not; it is how to design an effective blend. In this paper, technologies, information platforms used for learning, and concepts underlying the course are under discussion. One of the concepts – cross-cutting technology usage – is discussed in detail. The results of the course accomplished by the final test are presented at the end of the paper. This course implementation in 2020 was a pilot one, and, according to the results, this experiment was recognized as a successful one in terms of the learning effect. Usage of different channels, technologies and teaching methods in combination has proved the effectiveness of blended learning, while the results obtained in each activity (in terms of marks) have balanced each other.

articleTitle: Implementing a Modular System to Teach Students the Basics of Case-Based Reasoning Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the implementation of a modular case-based reasoning system for data mining based on previous experience in the form of cases. The case-based reasoning system allows you to work with cases presented in a parametric and structured (based on ontologies) form. This software focuses on the study by students of the basic principles of data mining and uses in the educational process in the laboratory workshops of the MPEI Department of Applied Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence.

articleTitle: Information Technologies for Training of Specialists on the basis of Designing Costs for Electric Power Transmission in Overhead Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper considers the use of information technologies for estimating the specific discounted costs of electricity transmission in overhead power lines, as well as in engineering education. The software implementation of the mathematical model makes it possible to estimate the costs of transmitting electricity to consumers in order to save energy. The advantage of the computer model is the dynamic visualization of the simulation results when selecting the physical parameters of the model in the specified ranges to minimize costs when transmitting electricity to end consumers. The developed software package is designed to train students on the basis of the project method in the engineering education of power engineers.

articleTitle: Noise Propagation Modeling From Large Industrial Facilities in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article is about important issues of integrating the study of physical factors into environmental courses for engineering education. Considered modern trends in changing environmental legislation. It is rationing noise exposure and defining the boundaries of sanitary protection zones of industrial facilities. The global practice of sustainable development sets new requirements. The first is for the design of individual industrial facilities. The second is for the global optimization of urban infrastructure as a whole. At the same time, noise reduction issues merge the four Sustainable Development Goals. The article presents the experience of teaching thermal power engineering students. We teach them to take into account the physical factors from industrial facilities. Described the possible educational tasks with the help of modern software. Examples of physical factors modeling from heat power facilities are given. Approaches to the analysis of the results obtained are shown. Proposed an approach to noise zoning of the studied territory. Such approach simplifying the analysis of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Algorithms of Natural Language Dialogue with Intelligent Robot NAO Evolution
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article is devoted to the usage of anthropomorphic robot NAO Evolution in teaching process of bachelors and masters at Automation and Computer Engineering department of Vologda State University. The paper discusses the content and implementation of software system of the dialogue man-robot on natural Russian language using the software package Choreography and dialogue creation tool QIChat. Fragments of software modules that implement the developed features are given.

articleTitle: Advanced Training of Thermal Power Plant Operational Personnel through the Use of Digital Simulators
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The use of computer training tools based on digital simulators of technological objects in professional training provides an increase in the psychological stability of operational personnel in emergency situations, a reduction in the number of technological violations associated with personnel errors, as well as an increase in the level of reliability and trouble-free operation of equipment, safety property management, safety and health of personnel of electric power facilities. The use of computer simulators also increases the cognitive activity of students, while ensuring the safety of both students and equipment. Professional training of operational personnel using software and hardware complexes is implemented in PJSC Mosenergo, and therefore the article presents some results of work in this area.

articleTitle: Modeling and Investigation of a Conveyor-Type Microwave Installation for Heating Bulk Materials
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article presents the results of studies of electrodynamic and thermal fields in a bulk dielectric during heat treatment in a conveyor-type microwave installation. As radiating systems, two slotted waveguide antennas operating at a frequency of 2.45 GHz were used. To obtain the most uniform distribution of the electric field strength and temperature on the dielectric surface, the optimal number of radiating slots and the relative position of the antennas were selected. The study was carried out using numerical simulation of the microwave heating process using the finite element method implemented in the COMSOL Multiphysics software. The influence of the power of microwave radiation and the velocity of movement of the conveyor belt on the intensity of heating the dielectric has been studied. The heating mode is implemented by selecting the optimal velocity of the conveyor belt and the power of microwave radiation, at which a given heat release and uniformity of heating in the dielectric are ensured.

articleTitle: Web Resource for Teaching Programming in the Form of Tournaments
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article presents a web resource intended for use in the practical lessons on programming in the process of IT students training. This resource supports the process of implementing tournaments between game computer programs developed by students, which allows us to add competitive and game elements to the learning process. The architecture of the developed resource and some aspects of its implementation are explained. The example of the practical application of designed web resource is shown.

articleTitle: Universal Simulator of Eddy-current Flaw Detectors for Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Training nondestructive testing specialists is a very important task. There are many different companies that produce a huge variety of non-destructive testing devices, including eddy-current testing flaw detectors. Educational centers should have a very large number of eddy-current flaw detectors. They are very expensive. To purchase them large economic investments are required. To teach a whole group of students, many units of each eddy-current flaw detector are required. To solve this problem, a simulator of eddy-current flaw detectors was developed and created. The purpose of the development was creation of universal device that could be connected via USB to a PC. It will be possible to select the interface of any required eddy-current flaw detector on the computer screen. If necessary, it will be possible to create additional interfaces for new flaw detectors. This does not require buying a huge variety of eddy-current flaw detectors. It will be enough to buy personal computers and connect to them universal simulator of eddy-current flaw detectors. This will lead to great money savings. Universal simulator of eddy-current flaw detectors cannot replace the devices themselves in real conditions, but this will be enough for educational purposes.

articleTitle: New Opportunities for Boiler Plants Calculation
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This paper discusses joint calculation of pulverized coal boilers and pulverization systems problems. Usually, two different programs were used for this, and the calculation was carried out by the method of successive approximations. This approach was time consuming. It also had other disadvantages. To eliminate these problems, JSK «OptSim-K», together with the Department of Power Engineering Design (NRU MPEI), released a new version of Boiler Designer program. It is sufficient to use this version to perform such calculations now. Investigations time costs are reduced, and the previous approach disadvantages are eliminated at the same time.

articleTitle: Automated Checking of Knowledge of Lab Works on the Course “Thermodynamics”
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The task was set to automate the process of protection to control knowledge in the process of defending laboratory work in the course "Thermodynamics". The article proposes the experience of the Department of Theoretical Foundations of Heat Engineering. M.P. Vukalovich (TOT named after M.P. Vukalovich) NRU MPEI for automated testing of students' knowledge on the performed topic of laboratory work. A feature of automated work protection is the ability to organize the protection process in a laboratory equipped with computers, and organize the protection process in a remote form. Remote access allows you to check level of knowledge on-line.

articleTitle: Using ANSYS to Study the Supply Geometry Influence on Cooling Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the application of the ANSYS Fluent software calculation complex for fluid dynamics to solve the problem of studying the interaction between the form and geometry of the cooling air supply channel to the surface of a gas turbine blade and the cooling efficiency. The object of research is a barrier film, formed on the surface of a turbine blade.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Systems with a Nonlinear Elastomeric Isolator in Simulink
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper presents Simulink models of nonlinear elastomeric isolator (EI) widely used in mechanical engineering and construction for vibration protection of structures. Models with a hysteretic bilinear deformation diagram and, for comparison, with a bilinear diagram without hysteresis are considered. Step and frequency responses are obtained and investigated; conclusions are given. The elements of the study will be helpful for the development of the professional skills and competencies of young engineers in the field of applied problems of vibration and shock protection; it can be a basis for the development of more complex multidimensional systems.

articleTitle: Computer Geometric Modeling Course for Construction Students
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The content of a special computer-graphic course for training construction major students of the SUSU elite group is presented. The topics of lectures and the content of control and graphic tasks are given. The tasks provide for the construction of original models of architectural objects. There is also a task for visualization of surfaces specified by an analytical expression, with programming elements in the AutoLisp language. One of the tasks involves the construction of animation using AutoCAD. All the constructions are performed as photorealistic ones (light, shadows, materials and perspective). Conclusions are made about the positive experience of teaching the course, and about the development of students' creative abilities. This course is focused on 3D modeling in the AutoCAD package.

articleTitle: Improve the Reliability of the Organization’s Resources to Support Remote Education Services
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The problem of improving the reliability of the organization's critical access resources is discussed in this article. In the educational sphere, such resources include examination systems, distance learning, videoconferencing, etc. We consider the case of a two-node high availability cluster based on software for configuring fault-tolerant Pacemaker systems Pacemaker and a DRBD distributed file system, which ensures the operation of an organization's website and a MySQL database server in active-passive mode. The configuration is shown for most of the used HA-cluster resources.

articleTitle: Changes in Approaches to Automation of Design and As-Built Documentation Procedures at Hazardous Production Facilities in the Russian Energy Sector
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Documentary support of construction of hazardous industrial facilities (such as thermal power plants, high-pressure gas pipelines, chemical plants, etc.) is a mandatory part of the process of implementation and presentation of the facility to the responsible supervisory authorities both in Russia and abroad. This article reviews the established and current requirements for design and as-built documentation and analyzes the latest trends in this area in Russia.

articleTitle: Software Application for Calculating Tanks for the Synthesis of Flexible Schemes for Wastewater Treatment of Chemical Technological Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The developed algorithm for calculating the tank system in the synthesis of flexible wastewater treatment schemes and the software application "Auxiliary_tank" created on its basis is presented. The interface, functions and practical use of the program are described on the example of a flexible scheme for the production of three drugs: emoxypine, lidocaine and carbazole.

articleTitle: Module for Determining the Technological State of Lease Automatic Custody Transfer Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the relevance of the use of information systems in the oil industry, in particular – monitoring systems. The article describes the metrological equipment "Oil custody transfer metering system" (CTM). An integral part of the CTM work is monitoring its condition.One of the existing solutions for monitoring CTM is being developed by the Russian IT company CROC Incorporated. The article discusses the experience of designing and developing a module for determining the technological state of the CTM, which should become part of the solution of CROC Incorporated and become part of the solution for one of the leaders of Russia in the oil industry.The article proposes an approach for determining the technological state of the CTM depending on the operation status of each individual element located on the CTM. The first stage involves the interpretation of the CTM scheme as a mathematical graph and the application of the K-shortest path search algorithm to the graph. The second stage consists in analyzing the found paths and determining their state as part of the work of the CTM.To test the presented approach, a prototype of the module for determining the technological state of the CTM has been developed. One of the properties of the module is a universal interface for receiving the initial data of the CTM from various source systems. Due to this property, the module was able to integrate with the Microsoft Visio platform, in which various initial CTM diagrams were formed.In the presented material, the step-by-step application of the module for CTM with two measuring lines is considered. The material may be of interest not only from the point of view of approbation on real projects, but also in the process of advanced training of specialists operating the CTM.

articleTitle: Establishment of Criteria for Assessing Preproduction Engineering in CAD TP
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper shows that the specificity of single and small-scale instrument-making and machine-building production involves the simultaneous implementation of a significant number of contracts (a large number of orders in production at the same time), which implies a simplified and not always adequate production design engineering. It is proposed to carry out preproduction engineering in the CAD systems for technological processes based on the organizational and technological design concept. The paper shows the basic principles of organizational and technological design. It presents and analyzes the set-theoretic and temporal models of the production system, which allow identifying the criteria for preproduction engineering. It also shows the production system subjects and objects and the time points for determining the specified criteria. The set-theoretic models shown in the work are investigated.
