The paper shows that the set-theoretical model of the procedure for establishing the criteria for preproduction engineering reflects the information structure of the production system, and the temporal structure provides time synchronization of the procedures performed.

articleTitle: Development of an Arc Breakdown Simulation Model for Its Practical Use in Low Voltage Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Development of dedicated software for analyzing the currents under fault conditions in a network has quite important prospects. A computer program simulating real emergency conditions of network operation is able to yield much more accurate data in comparison with the analysis procedures suggested in regulatory documents. This is especially the case in simulating arc faults, because models take into account the arc breakdown nonlinearities. In addition, a study of arc characteristics will help develop and further sophisticate special equipment for protection against the occurrence of arch breakdowns in a network. In this article, we present our developments of an arc simulation model in the Matlab/Simulink software package and suggest an algorithm of a program for numerically analyzing the currents occurring under fault conditions in a low voltage distribution network.

articleTitle: The Application of the Technology "Blended Learning" in Teaching of a Foreign Language at a Non-Linguistic University
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This paper researches the possibilities of implementing a model of «Blended learning» in teaching a foreign language at a non-linguistic university. Thus, in the situation of the coronavirus pandemic, distance learning technologies have become the only way to organize the educational process. Blended learning model can minimize the disadvantages of distance learning and also in future it can be used to restore the educational process after the pandemic. This model of teaching incorporates all the strengths of traditional and distance learning, eliminating the learning process from their disadvantages.

articleTitle: Utilisation of Electronic Games and Simulators in the Educational Process to Maintain and Train Human Brain and Physical Activity in a Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article researches the problems of utilization of electronic games and simulators modeling, which is carried out during the educational process within the framework of the disciplines "Design and administration of information systems", "Design of databases" and others. In addition, design is carried out in the classroom of the student scientific society (circle) "Studying the basics of programming, electronics and robotics." It is shown that the design results are, in particular, electronic games and simulators for maintaining and training human brain and physical activity in a pandemic. The target audience of the developed games and simulators is staff at remote work who spend unnecessarily large amounts of time at the computer. Specific examples of the corresponding hardware and software developments are given.

articleTitle: Use of Games Forms of Learning in Distance Education on the Example of Physics Experiments
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the use of game forms of learning in the process of distance education for schoolchildren. Using the example of the demonstrating of Coulomb's law, the application of the game approach in the development of teaching and knowledge-testing material in physics is shown. An application has been developed in the Unity environment that simulates the physical interaction of electric charges and visualizes the physics experiment. Application placement on the Internet portal for distance education. An example of an application to demonstrate the law of conservation of energy is shown too.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Software Complexes in the Calculation of the Cavity Cooling System of an Electric Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: When designing electrical machines, it becomes necessary to assess the temperature state of its active parts. There are several approaches to assessing thermal processes and designing cooling systems using various software products, each of which has its own advantages and disadvantages. The paper proposes an approach to modeling a cavity cooling system for an electric machine in Ansys Fluent. The results of calculating the cavity cooling system of an electric machine, obtained in Ansys Fluent and Ansys Motor-CAD, have been evaluated.

articleTitle: Heat Technology Installations Simulation in the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The research focuses on the development of mathematical models of processes and installations of industrial thermal power engineering, as well as the presentation of software products created in Mathcad and Microsoft Visual C++ codes. A significant part of Mathcad programs is freely available on the Internet as part of four blocks. The first block "Heat engineering tasks" presents programs for calculating the material balance of the complete combustion of gaseous and condensed fuels; characteristics of the combustion process based on the results of the exhaust gases composition analyses; the material balance of the glassmaking process; determination of the equilibrium composition of the incomplete combustion products of fuel, gasification of solid fuel, steam reforming of natural gas. The block contains programs for calculating the temperature characteristics of the combustion process - calorimetric and theoretical fuel combustion temperatures and provides the possibility of computational analysis of the thermal balance of a fuel high-temperature installation. Programs of approximation of experimental and computational data by an arbitrary analytical function are presented. The second block of programs "Gasification plant" contains software implementation of mathematical models and installations of solid fuel gasification processes. The third block of programs "Conversion" combines programs for calculating the processes of exhaust gases heat thermochemical recuperation from high-temperature industrial plants–a promising direction of fuel economy. These programs are used in the study of energy saving issues in industry. The fourth block of "Hydrogenium" programs is focused on the study of hydrocarbon conversion processes that play an important role in hydrogen energetics. The opportunity to study the efficiency of utilization of thermal and material waste of high-temperature installations to reduce the energy intensity of hydrogen production is provided. Studying the processes and installations of pyrolysis of carbon-containing materials, a mathematical model of a heat exchanger-cooler of fine coke residue is used. The software implementation of the model is performed in the Microsoft Visual C++. The developed software products are used in the educational process in the preparation of bachelors, masters, postgraduates, in scientific and engineering practice.

articleTitle: Measurement of the Degree of Humidification of Insulation Gaps of High-Voltage Energy Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the problems of establishing and assessing the degree of humidification of a paper-oil insulation system, for further assessment of the condition of the insulation system. Modern methods for determining the humidity of insulation, such as methods of return voltage and methods of dielectric spectroscopy, their basic principles and disadvantages are presented. The authors propose to use the polarization index as a control parameter, which is characterized by the ratio of the values of the polarization current in from the function of the time. The article presents the dependences of the polarization current in the insulation interval on the time of voltage application with different values of insulation humidity. The article describes the functional relationship between the revealed dependencies of the polarization index on the degree of moisture content of materials, and the magnitude of the degree index in the Cure-von Schweider equation. In their work, the authors consider a pattern that reveals the dependence of the number of breaks in the polymer chain of macromolecules of insulating paper on the degree of its moisture. Innovative is the fact that the proposed method for measuring the degree of humidification of the insulating structure of an electrical device is practically not affected by the ambient temperature, since the studied polarization curve passes through an isopermanent point.

articleTitle: The State and Perspectives of Corrective Reagents Dosing Systems as the Cycle Chemistry Monitoring at Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The organization of the corrective reagents dosing systems operation to maintain water quality and steam during the conduct of the cycle chemistry at thermal power plants is considered. In this paper, the corrective reagents automatic dosing system work was studied from the assessing position the typical disturbances influence, the most common in the practice of cycle chemistry conducting, and taking them into account in order to improve and optimize the cycle chemistry operation control systems. An improved system of corrective reagents automatic dosing with feed water consumption compensation and checking results its operability in relation to ammonia and polyamine cycle chemistry of combined cycle power plants are presented.

articleTitle: Application of Cad in Teaching Simulation of Electrophysical Parameters of High-Voltage Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses the main aspects of the computer-aided design systems (CAD) application in teaching the modeling of electrophysical parameters of high-voltage electrical equipment. The paper deals with theoretical and practical issues of using the software packages COMSOL Multiphysics, Solidworks Simulation, NX 11.0. The algorithm of using the program, which allows to master the subtleties of work, is described.

articleTitle: Comparison of Modeling Approaches in the Training Simulators Development for the Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Digitalization in the field of application of simulators of operational personnel of thermal power plants requires an increase in: flexibility; scalability; complexities; and increase the areas of use of simulators of operational personnel of thermal power plants. In this regard, it is necessary to take into account the differences in physical processes occurring in the simulated equipment, taking into account the use of simulators not only for the purpose of training, but also in other areas.

articleTitle: A Method for Planning R&D Activities Based on a Set of Models
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This article discusses a method for planning R&D projects that bring engineering professionals' knowledge of the R&D arrangement and its peculiarities to bear on the challenges of planning new R&D projects. Reducing planning uncertainty is achieved by a set of models proposed. The knowledge of R&D arrangement and the company's intellectual capital encapsulated into the ontological model that provides estimates of several indicators of R&D. The simulation model uses indicators obtained with the R&D ontology for assessing time characteristics of R&D activities the feasibility of R&D deliverables. The article also presents examples of the models' work.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Turbulence Models for Flow and Heat Transfer of Drop-Shaped Tubes
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Heat transfer and turbulent flow passing over a single tube and a bundle of drop-shaped tubes have been simulated by Ansys Fluent package. Five two-transport-equation turbulence models were considered. The strengths and weaknesses of the studied models have been studied. The numerical results were compared with the available experimental data. In addition, the capability of turbulence models to predict a flow pattern around the tubes was presented.

articleTitle: Mobile Literacy and Digital Competences of Foreign Language Teachers in Higher School
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Active use of information and communication technologies (ICT) in the professional activities of educators is a priority in modernizing education around the world. These technologies not only enrich the professional practice of the teacher but also help the student to adapt to the world of digital technologies. The article presents the experience of the Department’s of Foreign Languages staff at a technical university, acquired as a result of a sudden transition to distance education due to the 2020 pandemic. Data on the technical and methodological readiness of foreign language teachers for online work are given. In addition, survey data of undergraduate students regarding their satisfaction with the teaching staff’s level of proficiency in ICT, as well as overall satisfaction with remote work are presented. Spearman’s correlation coefficient indicates the relationship between teachers’ computer and mobile literacy and the students’ overall satisfaction with distance learning.

articleTitle: Software Application for the Research of Optical Properties of Matrix Photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of modern matrix photodetectors of multilayer type. A sensor that works in both the visible and infrared range is presented. A method for calculating optical parameters by programming in the Delphi language is presented. Based on the developed program, the screening angles and edge angles of incidence of rays on the developed multi-layer sensor are calculated. The results obtained were analyzed. The developed program will allow you to select the best parameters for the operation of a multilayer sensor, as well as to implement various combinations of layers. It is proposed to implement the program in the laboratory work.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Job-flow Online Scheduling and Resources Allocation in Distributed Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In this work we study a promising approach for efficient online scheduling of job-flows in high performance and distributed parallel computing. The majority of job-flow optimization approaches, including backfilling and microscheduling, require apriori knowledge of a full job queue to make the optimization decisions. In a more general scenario when user jobs are submitted individually, the resources selection and allocation should be performed immediately in the online mode. In this work we consider a neural network prototype model trained to perform online optimization decisions based on a known optimal solution. For this purpose, we designed MLAK algorithm which implements 0-1 knapsack problem based on the apriori unknown utility function. In a dedicated simulation experiments with different utility functions MLAK provides resources selection efficiency comparable to a classical greedy algorithm. The interdisciplinary nature of the considered problem and its solution (including elements from the areas of optimization, scheduling algorithms, machine learning and simulation) makes it a good study example in technical disciplines.

articleTitle: Application of Distance Learning Technologies to Create Simulation Modeling Applications in Technical Physics
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: A new course for distance learning in imitation modelling is presented. The course includes theoretical lessons and a set of practical tasks. To consolidate the material, tests are offered after lectures. The practical tasks are step-by-step programming of charged particle fluxes scattering in inhomogeneous multilayer media. The programming language is MatLab. As a result of performing all these tasks, students get a simulation model of interaction of particles with solid that could be applied to real scientific research. Student of MPEI have already studied this course and some of them went on scientific research in the field of particle interaction with solid.

articleTitle: Methods of Measuring Temperature and Pressure on Virtual Laboratory Stands
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The format of distance learning for students is increasingly being included in the educational life of teachers and university students. One of the urgent tasks of such training is to translate the process of performing laboratory work on real experimental installations into an online format. One of the most promising options for conducting remote laboratory work is the creation of simulation models of real installations - virtual stands with varying degrees of detailing of the physical processes taking place in them. This article discusses some of the advantages and disadvantages of using virtual benches over their physical counterparts. The features of modeling and some methodological solutions for creating virtual stands in the LabView program are considered. The description and appearance of virtual stands for performing two laboratory works in the discipline "Experimental research methods" are given. In a virtual stand to learn temperature measurement techniques, students can calibrate a thermocouple and calibrate electronic and mercury thermometers with a platinum resistance thermometer. On a virtual stand for teaching gauge pressure measurement methods, students can test the spring-loaded gauge and MIDA gauge, and then draw conclusions about the metrological characteristics of the instruments. The prototypes of the developed virtual stands are real laboratory installations where classes are held with students. At the moment, the creation of virtual stands is considered the most successful and inexpensive way to conduct laboratory work in distance learning. Despite the fact that this method is relatively simple, the implementation of laboratory work on its basis requires a serious study and understanding of the physical processes of the studied phenomena.

articleTitle: Approach to Develop an Intelligent User Support System of the Educational Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article describes an approach to the development and the results of testing of an intelligent user support system (USS), applicable, as well, to the educational platform of online courses to solve problems of information support for students.

articleTitle: Programming STM32 Nucleo Platform for IoT Education Using STM32duino and Mbed OS
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: In this article we consider STM32 Nucleo programming for the tasks of Internet of Things (IoT) education for Industry 4.0 using STM32duino and Mbed OS projects. A brief comparison of the Nucleo-64 F446RE board with popular Arduino Uno and Mega boards is done. We present programs to allow IoT device to communicate via Ethernet, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi interfaces. The assessment of the applicability of STM32duino, the Mbed library and the Mbed operating system in engineering student learning tasks is done as the main result of this article.

articleTitle: Ontological Engineering on Metagraphs Basis
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of ontological engineering of a complex cyber-physical system. An example of such a system is a system that automates processes in higher education institutions. Ontological engineering is the process of designing and developing ontologies that combines two main technologies for designing complex cyber-physical systems - object-oriented and structural analysis. The goals of ontological engineering are to increase the level of integration of information necessary for making management decisions, increase the efficiency of information retrieval, and provide an opportunity for joint processing of knowledge based on a single semantic description of the knowledge space. Ontological engineering is carried out within the framework of the proposed approach to managing complex cyber-physical systems. The resulting ontology should be a convenient and flexible basis for modeling processes and ensuring the functioning of information and analytical processes in a complex system. Approaches to ontological engineering based on graphs are considered. The application of ordinary graphs, hypergraphs and metagraphs is described. The use of metagraphs in the construction of hierarchical ontologies has been substantiated. Metagraphs are considered as the basis for building an applied system ontology. A modification of the metagraph is proposed to include events and system methods in the ontology. This approach to the construction of a metagraph allows to include the process component in the ontological model of the system as an integral part of it, which allows to flexibly and with lower time expenses form process models based on segments of the general ontological model. An example of the implementation of a software-instrumental environment for ontological engineering and further construction of models of processes of a complex cyber-physical system is presented. The technology used to implement the ontological model in the database and the structure of the database for storing the ontology are described.

articleTitle: Automated Formation of the Unified Ontological Space of Students’ Knowledge and Skills to Implement Intellectual Tutoring Tasks Based on Tutoring Integrated Expert Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The experience of development and use in the educational process of NRNU MEPhI of tutoring integrated systems, created on the basis of problem-oriented methodology and AT-TECHNOLOGY workbench, is analyzed. The focus of this work is on the place, role and features of the development and application of courses / disciplines applied ontologies to design the basic components of tutoring integrated expert systems - student models and student models.

articleTitle: Text Vectorization Method Based on Concept Mining Using Clustering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: With the incredible increase in the amount of text data, the need to develop efficient methods for processing and analyzing it increases. In this context, feature extraction from text is an urgent task to solve many texts mining and information retrieval problems. Traditional text feature extraction methods such as TF-IDF and bag-of-words are effective and characterized by intuitive interpretability, but suffer from the «curse of dimensionality», and they are unable to capture the meanings of words. On the other hand, modern distributed methods effectively capture the hidden semantics, but they are computationally intensive, and uninterpretable. This paper proposes a new concept-mining-based text vectorization method called Bag of weighted Concepts BoWC that aims to generate representations with low dimensions and high representational ability. BoWC vectorizes a document according to the concepts’ information it contains, where it creates concepts by clustering word vectors, then uses the frequencies of these concept clusters to represent document vectors. To enrich the resulted document representation, new weighting functions are proposed for concept weighting based on statistics extracted from word embedding information. This work is a development of previous research in which the proposed method was developed and tested on a text classification task. In this work, empirical tests were extended to include tuning the parameters of the proposed method and analyzing the effect of each on the efficiency of the method. The proposed method has been tested in two data mining tasks; document clustering and classification, with five various benchmark data sets, and it was compared with several baselines, including Bag-of-words, TF-IDF, Averaged word embeddings, Bag-of-Concepts, and VLAC. The proposed method outperforms most baselines in terms of the minimum number of features and maximum classification and clustering accuracy.

articleTitle: Role Playing as a Method of Learning in Knowledge Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Role-play promotes a deeper understanding of the methods of building knowledge-based systems. Students are trained to interview experts to extract knowledge for intelligent systems and, at the same time, to argue their opinion. Role-play allows you to master the necessary skills of a knowledge engineer (cognitologist). Parsing errors allows you to point out opportunities that were not used when extracting knowledge. The role-playing game can involve not only two participants (student-"cognitologist" and student-"expert", but all members of the student group. The teacher has ample opportunities to adjust the course of the role-playing game.

Author Keywords: the role of the teacher in the "role-playing game"

articleTitle: Empowerment of LMS "Prometheus" for MPEI Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The paper presents the operation of the learning management system "Prometheus" with additional capabilities, which are not provided by the standard specification of the system. The empowerment of the learning management system was made to organize high-quality training within educational environment of National Research University "Moscow Power Engineering Institute". The technique of automatic generation of test tasks in the format of LMS "Prometheus" is described. The export of students’ grades from the LMS "Prometheus" to MPEI educational process information system "BARS" is considered. The integration of objects into the testing system of LMS "Prometheus" is considered, scenarios for using PDF multimedia objects in the testing system is shown.

articleTitle: University Digital Maturity Profile as a Tool of Higher Education System Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Digital transformation is an extremely popular practice when the business models of organizations are changing in all industries around the world. In the Russian Federation achieving digital maturity of key sectors of the economy and social sphere is a national development goal until the 2030 year. The development of a system for assessing the state and monitoring of digital maturity is relevant in theoretical and methodological terms. Within the framework of this study, attention is paid to the organization of the higher (university) education system. It was noted that the existing approaches and methods for assessing digital development and digital maturity, as a rule, take into account the infrastructural factors of digitalization (material-technical factors, informational resources, human resources) and the results of the digitalization of educational products. In the model proposed by the authors, it is suggested to assess the digitalization of business processes and the digitalization of the work environment of students, teachers, and administrative personnel with the allocation of models: a model of a digital university, digital teaching methods, and the formation of the student experience, research and development area, campus and student life, administrative functions, functions of the teaching staff, university management and funding model, personnel, information and communication technologies. In the context of these models, authors highlighted the parameters that characterize the conditions and results of digital transformation with a specification to the result in terms of digital parameters and socio-economic effect. The proposed model can serve as a basis for building a digital maturity profile of a university, become a tool for diagnosing the current state of digitalization, determining the strengths and priorities of digital development.

articleTitle: Digital Competence of Students, Postgraduates by means of Cross-cutting Digital Technologies in the Educational Process of Universities
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to identify priority areas of cross-cutting digital technologies in the educational process of students and postgraduates, as well as to determine the role of digital technologies in their education. To conduct this research, we used the method of interviewing respondents from different universities of the Russian Federation on this issue. Using the survey method, it was found that 50% of universities are satisfied with the use of cross-cutting technologies. The teaching staff has been trained and plans to provide training on the use of cross-cutting technologies in the educational and scientific process of students and postgraduates. Based on the generalization and systematization of cross-cutting technologies used in engineering education, competitive advantages in their application and the increment of new competencies of students and postgraduates are also highlighted. As a result, it is proposed to distinguish between three levels of competencies, such as elementary, basic and advanced. The survey allows us to conclude that this process is developing at different speeds and universities are facing various problems that require further consideration and study in the future.

articleTitle: Technology of Designing an Effective Educational Program when Implementing an Engineering Education in the Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses modern educational technologies of higher education used to train engineering personnel in demand by the economy at this stage of the digital state development. Modern state educational standards are based on the methods of the competent approach when designing educational results, focused on correlation with professional standards. However, the labor functions specified in these standards require additions in accordance with the situation of the labor market, the needs of a particular employer (production). It is also necessary to take into account the key competencies of the digital economy, which should be presented in the form of digital competencies - sets of skills and knowledge necessary to perform labor actions using digital technologies. The article discusses modern methods of designing a competence-based educational model and proposes a technology for the formation of educational results taking into account the requirements of the employer, which is the basis of an intelligent system for designing an optimal competence-based model of a higher educational institution graduate–one of the tools of informatization of the educational process of the higher educational institution.

articleTitle: Combined Multi-criteria Selection of Laptops for Distant Education: Criteria Weighting with AHP and Entropy/Hierarchy in TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: This paper presents a combined approach based on the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) and the objective weighting of criteria with Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) for selecting laptop computers. The grouping of evaluation criteria allows decomposing the subjective professional opinions of experts. Effective data-driven methods based on novel hierarchy concepts are introduced as a supplement to the traditional entropy. The case study is based on a real and recent dataset for 11 criteria and 12 alternatives from 4 major manufacturers of personal computers (PC) with a simulation of mass users' preferences.

articleTitle: Software Tools for Analyzing Information Security Incidents Based on Monitoring of Information Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article discusses approaches to the management of information security incidents in computer systems and networks. A comparative analysis of existing methods and means of incident analysis is carried out. A software tool has been developed to identify and analyze incidents based on monitoring various information resources of the system related to its security.

articleTitle: Online Dictionaries in Process of Foreign Language Learning in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article researches the possibilities of using online resources, namely online electronic dictionaries, in the process of foreign language learning in engineering education. The advantages of online dictionaries (easy access, time and space efficiency, free access, actual vocabulary, built-in sound synthesizer, great variety of languages, multifunctioning and links to different resources and communities) are pointed out and online bilingual and monolingual dictionaries are described. Cambridge Dictionary, Reverso Context and Multitran as most popular online dictionaries are observed in the connection with engineering education. Some peculiarities of the dictionaries are exposed. The search results on the example of electrical engineering terms "voltage" and "treeing" in Cambridge Dictionary, Reverso Context and Multitran are presented. Some practical developing skills suggestions in using online electronic dictionaries during class and independent work are given. A students’ guide to online electronic dictionaries practice includes some steps from choosing a dictionary according to a student’s needs to pronunciation tips (stress, syllables and sounds) and words meaning and collocations. A set of thirteen exercises aimed to help the engineering students to acquire skills of working with online electronic dictionaries of various types more successfully is exposed.

Author Keywords: the advantages of most online dictionaries

articleTitle: 25 Years of Teaching at the National Research University "Moscow Power Engineering Institute" on STEM Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article describes more than a quarter-century of teaching courses on STEM technology at the National Research University "Moscow Power Engineering Institute" (MPEI). The necessity of opening a STEM specialty in pedagogical universities and STEM journals in Russia is substantiated. Provides links to scripts and tasks for STEM classes.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Student Performance in a Foreign Language from the Perspective of the Transition to Distance Learning (statistical analysis)
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The article provides an overview of scientific publications covering the main problems of the education system in different countries in the conditions of forced distance work, as well as ways of coping with them. The article covers a computer comparative statistical analysis of empirical data on the performance in a foreign language of full-time students of technical areas of training who studied (1) in the classroom, (2) using only information and communication technologies (ICT) and (3) in a mixed format. The sample size was 1103 values of students’ grades for three academic years: 2018/2019 (only classroom learning), 2019/2020 (face-to-face education was replaced by distance learning) and 2020/2021 (mixed learning format). The article dwells upon the results of computer analysis using the nonparametric Mann-Whitney test for unrelated samples, Dwass-Steel-Critchlow-Fligner pairwise comparisons, which revealed statistically significant differences in student performance. The study revealed a negative correlation between the period and format of training and student performance. Thus, the statistical analysis carried out confirmed the working hypothesis about the influence of the teaching format on student performance. The limitations of the study are pointed out, which allow the results to be scaled with caution. It is emphasized that the question of the causes of this correlation lies beyond the scope of the current study and needs further development, but it refers to the prospects of the presented study.

articleTitle: Application of Simulink for the Study of Dual-Slope ADC
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: Currently, the number of digital measuring transducers of various physical quantities is growing in measurement and control tasks. The functioning of digital converters presupposes the presence of analog-to-digital converters (ADC) in their structure. Among the ADC architectures used, the principle of dual-slope integration can be characterized by high noise immunity and relative ease of implementation. In the tasks of studying the characteristics of dual-slope ADCs and educational tasks, the use of real chips or their prototypes in a large number of cases turns out to be inconvenient. It´s especially related to the study of metrological characteristics, which, due to the smallness of their values against the background of random signal fluctuations, is extremely difficult to determine on a real prototype. This paper is devoted to the development of a dual-slope ADC model using the Simulink simulation package. The proposed model allows us to evaluate the static and dynamic characteristics of the dual-slope ADC. Most ADC parameters (sampling frequency, input signal range, reference signal value, duration of the first integration cycle) are configurable via a dialog box with the user. The issues of suppression of stationary and random external interference are considered. Recommendations are given for choosing the duration of the first integration cycle depending on the type of noise interference in the input signal. The obtained analytical expressions are confirmed by the results of simulation modeling of the developed model. The resulting model can be widely applied in the educational process, especially in the format of online education.

articleTitle: The Experience of NRU "MPEI" in the Implementation of the Sustainable Development Principles in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2022 VI International Conference on Information Technologies in Engineering Education (Inforino)
abstract: The problem of climate change, recognized by the world community as one of the most significant in the 21st century, has determined the high relevance of the climate transformation of the Russian economy. The key task to ensure such a transition is the training of qualified engineering personnel with competencies in the field of sustainable development. The article examines the world experience in the field of education for sustainable development, describes the experience of implementing these principles at the National Research University "MPEI", assesses the compliance of the Development Program of the National Research University "MPEI" with the priority areas of the UNESCO Global Action Program for Education in the Field of Sustainable Development.
